summary.text: SENTRAL BYGG AS is a private limited company registered in Haugesund, founded 2021-01-05. SENTRAL BYGG AS does all types of carpentry work, and buys, sells and rents out property. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. The register shows 11 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 17 673 558 NOK and the annual result was -1 460 173 NOK; operating income was up from 16 285 108 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 364 660 NOK in 2024 to -1 460 173 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from -1 845 571 NOK in 2024 to -3 305 744 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Dag Arne Toft (daglig leder) and Jan Ove Stangeland (styrets leder), with 2 other board members. The registered employee count went from 14 on 2025-11-12 to 11 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Skåregata 135 on 2026-09-14.
